description: Test suite for allow-from module functions in a chat application, including tests for merging allowlists, resolving group allowlists, and sender ID permissions.

methods.name: mergeDmAllowFromSources
methods.description: Merges, trims, and filters empty values from the 'allowFrom' and 'storeAllowFrom' arrays, with optional dmPolicy filtering.

methods.name: resolveGroupAllowFromSources
methods.description: Resolves the group allowlist, preferring explicit group entries, with fallback to allowFrom array, and optional fallback disabling.

methods.name: firstDefined
methods.description: Returns the first argument that is not undefined from a list of values.

methods.name: isSenderIdAllowed
methods.description: Checks whether a sender ID is permitted based on the channel configuration and sender's identifier.

ctags.name: name
ctags.pattern: /^      name: "keeps pairing-store entries for non-allowlist policies",$/
